entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: A human Sword Avenger pilot from Penregon in Urza's army who later became Junior Artificer.

entities.name: Rendall
entities.description: Sanwell's younger brother, a cadet at the palace.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Sanwell's home town with a newly opened school.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Leader of the army Sanwell serves.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Opposing brother whose forces attacked Kroog.

entities.name: Llora
entities.description: Commander who died in the attack.

entities.name: Rica
entities.description: Fellow pilot who retreated with Sanwell.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Planted information in a Gixian agent.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Attack of Mishra's forces on Kroog.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Where Mishra planned to come physically.

events.summary: On the day of the Fall of Kroog, trainees were hastily promoted to pilots to defend against Mishra's forces.
events.quote: Sanwell and his fellow trainees were hastily promoted to full pilots

events.summary: Sanwell piloted Sword One under Llora and Tawnos; Llora and many others perished and Sanwell retreated with Rica.
In 57 AR Sanwell brought Urza news that Mishra planned to come to Argoth physically, information planted by Gix.
events.quote: brought the news to Urza that Mishra was planning to come to Argoth physically

relations.quote: He was the older brother of Rendall .
Sanwell was a Sword Avenger pilot from Penregon in Urza 's army during the Brothers' War.
